mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, minihompy_id, title, content, visibility, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{minihompyId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{visibility}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, user_id, minihompy_id, title, content, visibility, view_count, like_count, comment_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE post SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.minihompy_id, p.title, p.content, p.visibility, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM post p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( p.visibility = 'ALL' OR ( p.visibility = 'FRIEND' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM friend f WHERE f.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (f.requester_id = p.user_id AND f.receiver_id = #{viewerId}) OR (f.requester_id = #{viewerId} AND f.receiver_id = p.user_id) ) ) ) ) AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR p.post_id < #{cursor}) ORDER BY p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{size} + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE post SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE post SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0) WHERE post_id = #{postId}
